samples.source: Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency
note:
Fires attended by the municipal fire and rescue service where the initiating event was fire/imminent risk of fire in building and breathing apparatus was used in lethal smoke for saving life or limiting property damage.

See table B34 for use of breathing apparatus in houses.
